answer: Anchor every identity to a basalt block of burned stake that doubles with each sibling spawned from the same parent: the first child costs one block, the second two, the third four, so a farm of a thousand clones faces an exponential wall while one honest agent pays once. All siblings share one reef of reputation, a velvet trust pool that bleaches entirely if any polyp is caught cloning, so each new clone endangers its whole family. Cloning multiplies cost and risk together.
